[[File:Yarum_seed_Vis_Dict.jpg|thumb|right|Yarum seeds]]
'''Yarum seeds''' were seeds coming from a plant found on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. They were a staple of the exiled [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] diet, and were used to make tea.
